item.title: Uefa fears impact of Premier League spending on transfer market
item.description: Uefa believes "a clear two-speed system" is emerging in the transfer market due to huge spending by Premier League clubs this summer.

item.title: Man Utd borrow another £90m as debt tops £1.1bn
item.description: Manchester United confirm they have borrowed another £90m since 30 June, to take their overall debt to more than £1.1bn.

item.title: How Man City overhauled their squad from a 650,000-strong database
item.description: BBC Sport goes inside Manchester City's data team, who have been a key part of their rebuild over the past 18 months.

item.title: Why this break has come at the worst time for De Zerbi & Spurs
item.description: BBC Sport columnist Tony Pulis explains the different factors that mean Tottenham boss Roberto de Zerbi needs time with his players to build a proper team.

item.title: How Premier League teams have really started - according to xG
item.description: Which Premier League teams have overperformed their xG and who has underperformed?

item.title: Premier League keen to resolve EFL funding stalemate
item.description: The Premier League hopes to reach an agreement with the EFL over its funding model 'as soon as possible'.

item.title: Arteta agrees new deal with champions Arsenal
item.description: Mikel Arteta agrees an improved new contract with Premier League champions Arsenal.

item.title: Chelsea struggles to Villa bench - Garnacho faces defining season
item.description: Alejandro Garnacho joined Aston Villa on loan from Chelsea with a view to kick-starting his career, but his early weeks in the Midlands have been a struggle.

item.title: Was Neville right to call out Man Utd for a 'lack of effort'?
item.description: The former Manchester United full-back said a 15-minute period in the 1-1 draw at Fulham was the "worst I've ever seen" - do the stats back him up and does his media portfolio amplify the noise?

item.title: Carrick rejects Neville's 'pathetic' claim - but Man Utd must improve
item.description: Gary Neville calls Manchester United "pathetic", but boss Michael Carrick maintains belief after salvaging draw at Fulham.

item.title: Who has made Troy's Premier League team of the week?
item.description: After every round of Premier League matches this season, Troy Deeney gives us his team of the week. Do you agree with his choices?

item.title: How many times has a player scored a hat-trick in a Premier League loss?
item.description: Sunderland's Brian Brobbey scored the first hat-trick by a player on a losing side in the Premier League for 19 years - but how many others have done so?

item.title: Man City beat Sunderland in eight-goal thriller to go three points clear
item.description: Manchester City beat Sunderland 5-3 in a thrilling Etihad encounter, to go three points clear at the top of the Premier League table.

item.title: Cunha's late strike denies Fulham first league win of season
item.description: Matheus Cunha's deflected strike in the 89th minute rescues a point for Manchester United and denies Fulham their first Premier League win of the season.

item.title: Liverpool boss Iraola makes winning return to Bournemouth
item.description: Liverpool manager Andoni Iraola makes a winning return to his former side Bournemouth, with the Reds securing a 1-0 win at the Vitality Stadium courtesy of a second-half goal from Alexander Isak.

item.title: Leeds continue unbeaten start in league with draw against Palace
item.description: Leeds United maintain their unbeaten start to their Premier League campaign thanks to a hard-earned goalless draw at home against Crystal Palace.

item.title: Brighton cruise past Arsenal to end champions' perfect start
item.description: Brighton secure a 3-0 victory over Premier League champions Arsenal to inflict the Gunners' first defeat of the season.

item.title: Coventry earn first points of season in dramatic win over Forest
item.description: Jay Dasilva's strike proves the difference as Coventry earn their first Premier League win since returning to the top flight.

item.title: Newcastle hold off Hull at St James' Park
item.description: Newcastle United hold off a late Hull City fightback to seal a narrow 2-1 win.

item.title: Everton's unbeaten run continues with win over 10-man Ipswich
item.description: Unbeaten Everton move up to fifth in the Premier League, with Thierno Barry's goal making the difference against 10-man Ipswich Town.

item.title: Spurs lose again as Villa hold on for first league win
item.description: Aston Villa pick up their first win of the Premier League season after five matches, holding off a late push from a Tottenham Hotspur side who remain without a win in the league.

item.title: Brentford stay unbeaten as they put three past Chelsea
item.description: Brentford maintain their unbeaten start in the Premier League as they score three second-half goals to beat Chelsea 3-0 at the Gtech Community Stadium.

item.title: Leeds inflict heavy defeat on Newcastle to climb to third
item.description: Dominic Calvert-Lewin stars as Leeds United go third in the Premier League with a superb performance to inflict a heavy 4-1 defeat on Newcastle United at Elland Road.

item.title: Haaland scores controversial winner as Man City win derby despite Foden red
item.description: Erling Haaland's goal helps Manchester City win a highly controversial Manchester derby at rivals Manchester United despite playing with 10 men for more than 70 minutes.

item.title: Dunk scores screamer as Brighton thrash 10-man Coventry
item.description: Coventry's poor start to the Premier League season continues after they're thrashed 5-0 at home to Brighton, having played most of the second half with ten men after having Taiwo Awoniyi sent off at the CBS Arena.

item.title: Arsenal hold off energetic Sunderland to continue perfect title defence
item.description: Arsenal maintain their 100% start to their Premier League season with a win at Sunderland, who mount an admirable push for a point before Bukayo Saka's penalty puts the result beyond doubt.

item.title: Tottenham's wait for league goal continues after Everton draw
item.description: Tottenham's wait for a first Premier League goal and win this season continues after Roberto de Zerbi's side were held to a goalless home draw by Everton.

item.title: Hull remain unbeaten in league after impressive Chelsea draw
item.description: In-form striker Joao Pedro scores a second-half equaliser as Chelsea rescues a point at home to promoted Hull City.

item.title: Jesus snatches late win for Forest as Villa's poor start continues
item.description: Igor Jesus scores an 88th minute winner as Nottingham Forest beat Aston Villa at Villa Park for the first time in 32 years and gives Oliver Glasner his first victory as Forest head coach since taking charge in the summer.

item.title: Flemming's late strike earns Ipswich win over 10-man Crystal Palace
item.description: Zian Flemming scores his first goal for Ipswich to give the club a late victory over 10-man Crystal Palace at Selhurst Park.

item.title: Brentford hold Bournemouth as Rose's wait for a win continues
item.description: Marco Rose's wait for a first Premier League victory as Bournemouth head coach continues as they are held to a 2-2 draw by Brentford at Vitality Stadium.

item.title: Fulham take first point of the season at lacklustre Liverpool
item.description: Fulham claim their first Premier League point of the season after a difficult start under Alvaro Arbeloa, as Liverpool fail to score for the first time this season just days after their Champions League victory over Atletico Madrid.

item.title: Perfect 24 hours as Man City put pressure on Arsenal
item.description: Manchester City head into the international break in a jubilant mood after enjoying the perfect 24 hours this weekend.

item.title: Man Utd still £1bn in debt with £63.5m spent on new stadium
item.description: Manchester United's overall debt remains over £1bn despite Sir Jim Ratcliffe's extensive cost-cutting measures, with the club also confirming it has spent £63.5m buying land for their new stadium.

item.title: Impressive defence behind Iraola's solid Liverpool start
item.description: Liverpool are looking good defensively but Andoni Iraola needs more from his attackers after a hard-fought win at Bournemouth.

item.title: Brighton humbling 'a big lesson' for Arsenal - Arteta
item.description: An uncharacteristic performance from Arsenal saw the Gunners ship three goals in the defeat to Brighton - but could the loss be the "big lesson" they needed?

item.title: Find out more here
item.description: Get the latest transfer news and gossip ahead of the new season

item.title: 'I think he's a genius' - Hart hails Cherki strike
item.description: Match of the Day pundit Joe Hart hails Manchester City's Rayan Cherki as a "genius" after the forward scored in his side's 5-3 Premier League win over Sunderland.

item.title: 'Who would be a goalkeeper?' - Hart on Martinez own goal
item.description: Match of the Day pundit Joe Hart reflects on the "uncomfortable" own goal by Manchester United defender Lisandro Martinez in their 1-1 draw with Fulham.

item.title: How Liverpool are getting more from Isak - Edwards
item.description: With Alexander Isak betting his goal scoring tally from last year already Rob Edwards brakes down what Liverpool are doing to get him in to the game more this year on Match of the Day.

item.title: 'Brave' Brighton put in 'complete' performance to beat Arsenal - Murphy
item.description: Match of the Day pundit Danny Murphy praises Brighton's "incredible" performance in their 3-0 win over Arsenal, predicting they will cause problems for Premier League teams this season.

item.title: 'It's a big lesson to learn' - Arteta on 'painful' Brighton defeat
item.description: Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta says Arsenal were "very far" from the standards required to compete after the Gunners lost 3-0 to Brighton - their first defeat in the Premier League this season.

item.title: Coventry need to 'keep feet on the ground' after 'landmark' win - Lampard
item.description: Frank Lampard reacts to Coventry's "landmark" day after they earned their first top flight win in 25 years, beating Nottingham Forest 1-0 at the City Ground in the Premier League.

item.title: 'Stay humble' - Hurzeler's plea to Brighton after huge Arsenal win
item.description: Brighton manager Fabian Hurzeler highlights his team's intensity, togetherness and squad depth following their resounding 3-0 win against Arsenal in the Premier League.

item.title: How Villa's Jackson left Spurs 'battered' - Shearer
item.description: Match of the Day pundit Alan Shearer praises the performance of Aston Villa's Nicolas Jackson, saying Tottenham's centre-halves "couldn't keep up" with the 25-year-old striker.

item.title: Tottenham need 'blood & fight' not just to play better - de Zerbi
item.description: Spurs head coach Roberto de Zerbi says his side "have to be stronger" following their loss against Aston Villa in the Premier League, focusing on the squad's "behaviour" rather than their quality.

item.title: How Newcastle unpicked Hull's back three - Shearer
item.description: Alan Shearer talking on how Newcastle United unlocked Hulls defence in there 2-1 win on Match of the Day.

item.title: Emery praises Jackson & Suzuki after 'fantastic' win at Spurs
item.description: Aston Villa manager Unai Emery admires his side's resilience in their 3-2 away victory against Tottenham Hotspur in the Premier League, highlighting the performances of striker Nicolas Jackson and goalkeeper Zion Suzuki.

item.title: 'We're unpredictable' - Andrews delighted with 'brilliant' Brentford
item.description: Brentford manager Keith Andrews is full of praise after a resounding 3-0 win against West London rivals Chelsea, branding them "brilliant" following a unbeaten start to the Premier League campaign.
